title: FizzBuzz
statement: Read an integer n (1 <= n <= 100000). For each i from 1 to n print one line: "FizzBuzz" if i is divisible by 15, "Fizz" if divisible by 3, "Buzz" if divisible by 5, otherwise i.

scenarios.name: n = 15
scenarios.expected_output:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz
